posts.text: Location: Aalo, West Siang, Arunachal Pradesh Date: November 25 The Arunachal Pradesh Indigenous Youth Organisation (APIYO), led by its president Taro Sonam Liyak, called for a district-wide shutdown and organised a protest procession, raising slogans demanding the closure of Jama Masjid, which the organisation termed “illegal.” When a reporter questioned the organisation about its selective targeting of mosques, Liyak cited scenes from the film Dhurandhar 2 as evidence, claiming that madrasas store illegal weapons and teach students to kill “non-believers.”
